title: Claims feature deferred to wiki-claims-replay branch
summary: The wiki-memory claims feature failed its replay gates (G1, G2, G3) and was not merged to main; only the design doc landed, with code preserved on a feature branch.

fields.context: The feature to surface memory-written claims in the wiki dossier was replayed on 100 production sessions and all primary evidence gates failed: G1 47.6% (needed 60%), G2 10.8% (max 5%), G3 0.30 (min 0.9).
fields.decision: Land only the design document results in section 6.2 and keep the code on the feature branch wiki-claims-replay; do not start the 'claims live' rollout.

alternatives.option: Merge the claims code to main
alternatives.whyRejected: Evidence gates G1, G2 and G3 all failed the fixed thresholds.

fields.consequences: The claims feature remains off by default and inactive in production until the gates are re-evaluated.

title: session sum_* 列是 int4，长会话 cache read 累加会溢出
summary: 长会话累积 cache read 超 21 亿时，turn-complete 结算累加 sumCacheRead 导致 Postgres integer out of range，事务回滚且 turn 卡 IN_FLIGHT。

fields.fix: 已删列根治。紧急解堵：UPDATE session SET sum_cache_read = 0 WHERE 原值匹配，runner 重试即恢复
fields.cause: sumCacheRead 等 4 个 sum_* 列是 integer (int4, 上限 2147483647)，长会话多轮大上下文调用累加后超出上限，累加写入失败导致事务回滚
fields.symptom: turn-complete 上报失败，turn 一直 IN_FLIGHT，后续消息全部 queued，每分钟持续报溢出错误

title: session.sum_cache_read 是 int4，大会话会溢出卡死 turn-complete
summary: turn-complete 结算时累加 sum_cache_read，超过 2^31-1 时 Postgres 报 integer out of range，事务回滚导致 turn 永远 IN_FLIGHT，后续消息全部 queued。

fields.fix: 代码侧：删除 4 个 session.sum_* 列（迁移 0347），token 明细在 usage 表用 sum() 现算；紧急解堵：UPDATE session SET sum_cache_read=0 WHERE 原值锁定
fields.cause: sum_cache_read 是 integer(int4) 上限 2147483647，长会话累积超限后整个 turn-complete 事务回滚
fields.symptom: 会话消息持续 queued，turn 卡 IN_FLIGHT，引擎已完成但服务端不 ack，runner 无限重试 5xx

title: 部署生产走 orbit-prod 升级流程，无需所有者确认
summary: 把改动部署到生产时用 session_create 指定 agentName orbit-prod 执行仓库的 upgrade 流程，不需要所有者手动确认。

fields.rule: 部署到生产统一用 session_create 起 agentName orbit-prod 会话执行仓库 upgrade 流程，无需所有者再次确认
scope: 把 apiserver 等改动部署到 orbitd.io 生产
